en.topic_title: Hong Kong parents urged to vaccinate young children amid rising summer flu cases
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong parents have been urged to vaccinate their young children as cases of influenza among children have risen across the city.



Children play in a playground in September 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



Mike Kwan, honorary clinical associate professor of the Department of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine at the University of Hong Kong, said on Commercial Radio on Monday that flu-related hospitalisations of children have risen recently, with some patients experiencing fevers in excess
